analysis_scope: reanalysis of frozen stored rows; no model or router execution
estimand: equal-weight mean over the 400 observed model-example conditions

uncertainty.within_cluster_policy: retain all observed window-by-seed model conditions
uncertainty.population_limit: only 16 fixed synthetic identities; intervals are descriptive sensitivity summaries, not broad task-population claims
uncertainty.subgroup_membership: held fixed from observed path_gain within each resampled identity; selected-subgroup intervals remain post-treatment conditional
